complexityReason: Complete Sam's final seventeen rows together, closing his autumn forgetfulness and friendship, winter work branch, father's return timeline, guitar reminders and sledding wishes in one voice pass.

entries.winter_Fri: Na sněhu je nejhorší, že člověku promoknou nohy. Ještěže máš tak bytelné boty.
